title: Household insurance theft claim: Simple theft away from the insured location (CSS AVB Ziff. 24.2)

sources.title: Swiss Federal Chancellery, Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über den Versicherungsvertrag (Versicherungsvertragsgesetz, VVG) vom 2. April 1908, SR 221.229.1, consolidated version in force since 1 January 2024 (Stand am 1. Januar 2024); the latest consolidation Fedlex lists on 2026-11-12
CSS Versicherung AG: Hausratversicherung, Allgemeine Versicherungsbedingungen (AVB), Form. 519d-01.24-eff, Ausgabe 02.2024

CSS Versicherung AG: Schadenanzeige Hausrat / Gebäude (claim notification form), Form. 15d-09.26-pdf, Form. 15d-09.26 (PDF modified 2026-10-16); Study 1 used the earlier edition 15d-08.26 from the same URL
Convention of this benchmark (not law): Study 4 SPEC.md item 6a

facts.question: Which theft claim is this: theft at the insured location (theft_at_home), simple theft away from it (simple_theft_away), or something else (other)?

Does the file state that household contents were stolen outside the insured location, in a theft that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death)? (Not this: A theft at the insured location (the other claim type, Ziff. 23.3); items lost, left behind or misplaced.)

Does the file state that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)? (Not this: Another supplementary cover being missing; the claimant being unsure whether the cover exists (that is open).)

Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, for example by repair or cleaning? (Not this: Traces that exist and are left as they were, or were only photographed; the police examining the scene.)
Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items? (Not this: A motor scooter or motorcycle; bicycle parts or accessories alone.)

Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)? (Not this: The vouchers have not been attached yet or not been looked for; finding them is merely inconvenient.)

Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are or were to be taken after the theft, and that there was no imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug) requiring them before the insurer could be asked? (Not this: Measures that had to be taken at once because of imminent danger; the notification of the claim itself; steps to find the thief or recover the items.)

steps.title: Check that the reported event is a simple theft away from the insured location
Check that the policy includes the supplementary insurance for simple theft away
Record the claim notification and the policy
Check that the police were notified and an official investigation requested
source_refs: css-avb#Ziff. 8, Einleitung zu lit. f-h, S. 3

steps.title: Check the police's consent to removing or altering the traces
Check whether the insurer's instruction on loss-reduction measures is to be obtained

next.label: measures to be taken, no imminent danger

steps.title: Obtain and follow the insurer's instruction on the measures to be taken
Establish the stolen or damaged items and their value
Not a simple theft away from the insured location: this claim type does not apply
No cover: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away was not taken out

documents.title: Claim notification: the CSS form 'Schadenanzeige Hausrat / Gebäude', completed and signed
must_show: that and when CSS was notified of the theft
the signature under the declaration that all questions were answered truthfully and completely
documents.why: evidence: vvg VVG Art. 38 Abs. 1: «Ist das befürchtete Ereignis eingetreten, so muss der Anspruchsberechtigte, sobald er von diesem Ereignisse und seinem Anspruche aus der Versicherung Kenntnis erlangt, das Versicherungsunternehmen benachrichtigen.» The passage makes notifying the insurer a duty; the insurer's own claim form, completed and signed, is the document that ordinarily records that and when the insurer was notified.

documents.title: The insurance policy (Police)
must_show: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2)
documents.why: evidence: css-avb Ziff. 24.2, S. 8: «Schäden am Hausrat durch Diebstahl, der weder als Einbruchdiebstahl noch als Beraubung gilt und sich ausserhalb des versicherten Standortes ereignet, sind bis zu der in der Police vereinbarten Versicherungssumme mitversichert.» The clause covers the damage up to the sum insured agreed in the policy; the policy is the document that shows whether the supplementary cover was agreed and for which sum.

documents.title: Police report on the theft (Polizeirapport)
must_show: that the theft was reported to the police
that an official investigation was requested
documents.why: states: css-avb Ziff. 8 lit. f, S. 3: «Ein entsprechender Polizeirapport kann durch die CSS einverlangt werden»

documents.title: The police's consent to removing or altering the traces (a written confirmation, or the entry in the police report recording it)
documents.why: evidence: css-avb Ziff. 8 lit. f, S. 3: «ohne Zustimmung der Polizei die Tatspuren nicht zu entfernen oder zu verändern» The passage makes the police's consent the condition for removing or altering traces; once traces have been or are to be removed or altered, the police's written confirmation of that consent is the document that ordinarily shows the condition was met.

documents.title: List of the stolen or damaged items with their values (Verzeichnis mit Wertangaben)
documents.why: states: css-avb Ziff. 8 lit. c, S. 3: «auf Verlangen, ein Verzeichnis der vom Schaden betroffenen Sachen mit Wertangaben zu erstellen und Originalbelege beizubringen;»

documents.title: Original purchase vouchers for the stolen or damaged items (Originalkaufbelege)
must_show: where and when it was bought
documents.why: states: css-form Abschnitt 3.7 Gegenstände, S. 2: «Beschädigte oder gestohlene Sachen (bitte Originalkaufbelege beilegen)»

documents.title: Original purchase voucher for the bicycle
must_show: where and when it was bought
documents.why: states: css-form Abschnitt 3.9, S. 3: «Fahrrad (bitte Originalkaufbelege beilegen)»

outcomes.title: Not a simple theft away from the insured location: this claim type does not apply
No cover: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away was not taken out
